title: Robustness and hyperstability for the Erdős-Gallai theorem
summary: The Erdős--Gallai theorem states that every graph of average degree $d$ contains a cycle of length at least $d$. We prove the following robust extension of the Erdős--Gallai theorem: For every $c>0$ there exists $K$ such that for all $d\geq K$, $p\geq K/d$ and every graph $G$ with average degree $d$, the random graph $G_p$ obtained by independently sampling each edge of $G$ with probability $p$ contains a cycle of length at least $(1-c)d$ asymptotically almost surely as $|V(G)|\to \infty$.
